name: The Deserter
description: Fen Maro, the person hiding in Outpost Balor's basement, wants you to deliver a letter to Warden Holt and find their squad's supply cache.

deliver_letter.label: Deliver Fen's Letter to Warden Holt
deliver_letter.description: Return to Outpost Balor and give Fen's letter to Warden Holt.

find_cache.label: Find the Squad's Supply Cache
find_cache.description: Search near the old watchtower on the dark perimeter for Fen's squad's emergency supply cache.

completionActions.text: Quest complete: The Deserter. Fen's squad's cache contained rare military-grade equipment.
